p: earth empty: This prophecy is as a conclusion of that which has been threatened to the Jews and other nations from the 13th chapter and therefore by the earth he means those lands which were named before.

priest: Because this was a name of dignity it was also applied to them who were not of Aaron's family, and so signifies also a man of dignity, as in 2Sa 8:18, 20:25, 1Ch 18:17 and by these words the prophet signifies a horrible confusion, where there will be neither religion, order nor policy, Ho 4:9.
also is defiled under its inhabitants: That is, does not give her fruit for the sin of the people, whom the earth deceived of their nourishment because they deceived God of his honour.
curse devoured the earth: Written in the law, as in Le 26:14, De 28:16 thus the prophets used to apply particularly the menaces and promises which are general in the law.
burned: With heat and drought, or else that they were consumed with the fire of God's wrath.
confusion is broken down: Which as it was without order so now should it be brought to desolation and confusion: and this was not only meant of Jerusalem, but of all the other wicked cities.
mirth of the land is gone: Because they did not use God's benefits correctly their pleasures would fail, and they would fall to mourning.
as the shaking of an olive: He comforts the faithful, declaring that in this great desolation the Lord will assemble his Church which will praise his Name, as in Isa 10:22.
the sea: From the utmost coasts of the world, where the gospel will be preached as in Isa 24:16.
righteous: Meaning to God, who will publish his gospel through all the world.

My leanness: I am consumed with care, considering the affliction of the Church, both by foreign enemies and domestic. Some read, My secret, my secret: that is, it was revealed to the prophet, that the good would be preserved and the wicked destroyed.
windows from on high are open: Meaning that God's wrath and vengeance would be over and under them, so that they would not escape no more than they did at Noah's flood.
punish the host of the high: There is no power so high or mighty, but God will visit him with his rods.
visited: Not with his rods as in Isa 24:21 but will be comforted.

Then the moon shall be confounded: When God restores his Church, the glory of it will so shine, and his ministers (who are called his ancient men) that the sun and the moon will be dark in comparison to it.
